title: pamoja wiring
description: One site's wiring: the part that reads what a profile reads, the line its output drives, the link its readings go over, and the battery it runs from. pamoja-node reads it with the profile it names and runs the node.

$schema.description: The format the file is written in: this schema's address, or a copy of it by the same file name. An editor reads it to check the file as it is typed.

site.description: The site's name, such as coop-2, which the node's logs and its MQTT client id carry.

profile.description: The profile to run, as a path relative to this file, such as brooder-heater.json.

sensor.description: The part that takes the readings. It must measure the quantity the profile reads.

part.description: The part, as the table of parts names it.

bus.description: The I2C bus the part is on, such as /dev/i2c-1, or sim for the part's simulated twin, which answers with one fixed measurement. Every part but a ds18b20 and a replay needs one.

address.description: The part's I2C address, as a number or as hexadecimal text such as "0x77", when it is not the part's usual one.

serial.description: A ds18b20's 1-Wire serial, such as 28-0316a2795cff, as the kernel names its folder under /sys/bus/w1/devices.

readings.description: The readings a replay plays back in turn, in the profile's unit, for trying a profile with nothing wired.

offset.description: Added to each reading once it is in the profile's unit, to correct a probe that reads high or low.

scale.description: Multiplied into each reading before the offset is added.

output.description: The output a setpoint profile switches: a GPIO line, or a printed line for trying a profile with nothing wired. Leave it out for a profile that switches nothing.

oneOf.title: gpio
oneOf.description: A GPIO line, such as the input of a relay board.

line.description: The line on the chip, which on a Raspberry Pi is the GPIO number, such as 17.

active_low.description: true when the line is driven low to switch the output on, as most relay boards want.

oneOf.title: print
oneOf.description: Names the output in each tick's line instead of driving a line.

print.description: What the output is called in the text, such as heat lamp.

link.description: The link each reading is published over.

mqtt.description: The broker's host name or address.

port.description: The broker's port: 1883 unless given, or 8883 with tls.

client_id.description: The client id; the site's name unless given.

username.description: The username to sign in with.

password.description: The password to sign in with, which goes with a username.

oneOf.title: print
oneOf.description: Prints each reading with its topic instead of publishing it.

tls.description: TLS to the broker. An empty object trusts the system's certificate authorities.

ca.description: The certificate authority to trust, as a PEM file; the system's own unless given.

certificate.description: The client certificate to present, as a PEM file, for a broker that asks for one.

key.description: The client certificate's private key, as a PEM file, which goes with a certificate.

battery.description: The battery the node runs from, read as a voltage through a power monitor to set how often the node samples. Leave it out on mains power, and the node samples at the profile's active cadence.

part.description: The power monitor across the battery.

bus.description: The I2C bus the monitor is on, or sim.

address.description: The monitor's I2C address, when it is not 0x40.

empty_volts.description: The voltage the battery reads when it is empty.

full_volts.description: The voltage the battery reads when it is full, above empty_volts.
